mapper.sql: id, merchant_id AS merchantId, category_id AS categoryId, name, subtitle, main_image AS mainImage, sub_images AS subImages, description, detail_html AS detailHtml, price, status, audit_remark AS auditRemark, sales_count AS salesCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (merchant_id, category_id, name, subtitle, main_image, sub_images, description, detail_html, price, status, audit_remark, sales_count) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{mainImage}, #{subImages}, #{description}, #{detailHtml}, #{price}, #{status}, #{auditRemark}, #{salesCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, main_image = #{mainImage}, sub_images = #{subImages}, description = #{description}, detail_html = #{detailHtml}, price = #{price}, status = #{status}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
